NGLFINE.about: NGL Fine-Chem Limited develops and manufactures veterinary APIs, human APIs, intermediates, and finished dosage forms in India, Europe, the Asia Pacific, the United States, and internationally. The company offers afoxolaner, amitraz, atovaquone, buparvaquone, butaphosphan, carprofen, clorsulon, closantel base, closantel sodium, decoquinate, diminazene diaceturate, febantel, fenbendazole, fluazuron, flumethrin, flunixin meglumine, fluralaner, halquinol, homidium chloride, imidocarb dipropionate, isometamidium chlroide HCl, lotilaner, marbofloxacin, maropitant citrate monohydrate, nitroscanate, nitroxynil, oclacitinib maleate, oxfendazole, parvaquone, permethrin, phenazone, ponazuril, praziquantel, ractopamine HCL, rafoxanide, ricobendazole, r-praziquantel, sarolaner, s-methoprene, toldimfos sodium, toltrazuril, triclabendazole, xylazine base, xylazine HCl, and zilpaterol. It also provides anthelmintics, antiprotozoals, ectoparasiticides, phosphorus supplements, coccidiostats, and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. In addition, the company offers atovaquone, nitazoxanide, and praziquantel for anti malarial, anti diarrheal, and anthelmintic therapeutic categories. Further, it provides specialty chemicals, such as meglumine, n-ethyl-d-glucamine, n-octyl-d-glucamine, 1,4,7-trimethyl-1,4,7-triazonane, and Mn-MeTACN. It serves companies engages in manufacturing custom pharmaceuticals. NGL Fine-Chem Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

NH.about: Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited provides medical and healthcare services in India, the United Kingdom, and the Cayman Islands. It operates through the Medical and Healthcare Related Services; and Others segments. The company offers oncology, anesthesiology, audiology, blood bank, breast oncology, oncoplastic surgery, cardiac surgery, cardiology, clinical genetics, clinical immunology, clinical nutrition and dietetics, clinical psychology, congenital adult heart disease, cosmetology, cranio-maxillofacial surgery, critical care medicine, dental, dermatology, diabetology, ENT, emergency medicine, endocrinology, family medicine, general and GI surgery, general medicine and surgery, geriatric medicine, gynecology, hematology, headache and facial pain management, transplant, infectious diseases, neurology, radiology, hepatobiliary surgery, gastroenterology, minimal access GI and bariatric surgery, neonatology, nephrology, neuro-otology, neuro-rehabilitation, neurosurgery and spine surgery, and nuclear medicine services. It also provides ophthalmology, orthopedics and joint replacement, pain management and palliative care, pathology, perinatology and fetal intervention, physical medicine and rehabilitation, physiotherapy and physical rehabilitation, plastic surgery, psychiatry, pulmonology, reproductive medicine, rheumatology, renal science, speech and swallow rehabilitation, spine surgery, thoracic and vascular surgery, uro oncology, urology, and other services. In addition, the company acquires, owns, and operates hospitals, clinics, health centers, diagnostic centers, and nursing homes. Further, it provides health insurance, consultancy services in the field of healthcare and hospitals, and IT services related to healthcare. Additionally, the company engages in investment activities; and develops software related to the healthcare industry. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

NHPC.about: NHPC Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the generation, sale, and trading of electricity through hydro, wind, and solar power stations in India and Nepal. It also owns and operates power stations. In addition, the company offers consultancy, project execution, and maintenance services in the areas of design and engineering; geotechnical investigations; renovation and modernization of hydropower projects; procurement; project management and supervision; construction management; and operation and maintenance of power plants, rural road projects, and rural electrification projects. The company supplies electricity to various distribution companies, including state electricity distribution companies, state power departments, and private distribution companies. It exports its products and services. NHPC Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Faridabad, India.

NIACL.about: The New India Assurance Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the general insurance industry in India and internationally. The company offers motor, health, travel, rural, credit, engineering, aviation, personal accident, liability, marine hull, fire, marine cargo, and miscellaneous insurances, as well as rural micro products, such as cattle, sheep, goat, pig, and agriculture pumpset Sukshma Bima policies. It also provides reinsurance, bancassurance, state insurance plan, and parametric insurances. The New India Assurance Company Limited was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NIBE.about: Nibe Limited engages in the fabrication and machining of components in the defense sector in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Defence and Aeronautics. The company offers fabrication, machining, and assembly of components used in defence systems, as well as the manufacturing and maintenance of various electronic and mechanical systems for naval, land, air, and space applications. It also provides products and services such as weapons, communication devices, protective vehicles, defensive and deterrence systems, and related components. In addition, the company engages in aeronautics through the hiring and chartering of aircraft and provides aviation services. Further, it offers cable harness, integrated mobile shelter project, modular bridge project, cabel hardness & interconnect systems, missile project, subcontracting projects, electronics testing laboratory, satellite-based intelligence. The company was formerly known as Kavita Fabrics Limited and changed its name to Nibe Limited in July 2020. Nibe Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Mumbai, India.

NICCOPAR.about: Nicco Parks & Resorts Limited primarily engages in the operation of theme-based entertainment businesses in India. It operates through three segments: Park Operations; Consultancy, Contracts and Sale of Rides Components; and F&B and Other Recreational Facilities. The company operates theme parks, water parks, and recreational and associated facilities and activities. It also offers technical consultancy, project execution, and the supply of amusement ride components, as well as provides in-park food and beverage operations, events and banqueting services, and leased and licensed recreational facilities. The company also manufactures and supplies rides for large amusement parks in the United Kingdom, the rest of Europe, Dubai, and Japan. Nicco Parks & Resorts Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Kolkata, India.

NIITLTD.about: NIIT Limited engages in providing learning and knowledge solutions to individuals, enterprises, and various institutions in India and internationally. The company offers a variety of training programs, certifications, and solutions for career seekers and working professionals. The company also offers a program portfolio such as AI/ML, generative AI, data science, full-stack product engineering, 5g, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and game development, along with programs in digital marketing, business development, banking, insurance and finance, and virtual relationship management for digital enterprises. In addition, the company provides NIIT Digital, a platform that enables technology-enabled learning experiences for corporate and individual learners; the Institute of Finance Banking & Insurance (IFBI), a provider of learning services, including career-launch and career-advancement programs for professionals in the BFSI sector; StackRoute, a digital transformation partner for corporates to build multi-skilled full-stack professionals in advanced technologies; RPS Consulting, a provider of training programs on digital technologies; Talent Pipeline as a Service (TPaaS), helps organizations in hiring skilled talent; iamneo, an AI-powered SaaS platform that provides automated coding labs, assessments, placement automation, and talent acquisition solutions to university students and professionals; and NIIT Sales & Service Excellence (SSE) that helps organizations in creating robust talent ecosystem. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Gurugram, India.

NIITMTS.about: NIIT Learning Systems Limited provides managed training services in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. Its managed training services include custom content and curriculum design, learning administration and delivery, strategic sourcing, learning technology, and learning and development (L&D) consulting services. The company also offers digital transformation and IT training, immersive learning, customer education, talent pipeline as a service, DE&I training, as well as leadership and professional development training services.The company was formerly known as Mindchampion Learning Systems Limited and changed its name to NIIT Learning Systems Limited in January 2022. NIIT Learning Systems Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Gurugram, India.

NILE.about: Nile Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of pure lead for battery consumption in India and internationally. The company offers lead antimony, lead selenium, lead calcium, lead tin, and pure lead. It serves its products to manufacturers of lead acid batteries, PVC stabilizers, and lead-oxide. Nile Limited is based in Hyderabad, India.

NILKAMAL.about: Nilkamal Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells plastic products in India and internationally. The company offers bins and crates, pallets, material handling equipment, shelving and racking systems, insulated boxes, waste management solutions, road safety barriers for infrastructure management, and hospitality sector products for commercial food preparation and service, as well as provides related technical services. It also engages in the business of ready furniture, furnishings, accessories, and e-commerce; material handling, moulded furniture products, metal racking and storage, bubble guard for packaging and protection, factory made wood furniture, metal furniture, sofa manufacturing, office seating solutions, mattress and foam, and modular furniture. In addition, the company operates company-owned company-operated(COCO) and franchisee-owned franchisee-operated(FOFO) stores. It serves food and beverages, logistics, retail, automotive, e-commerce and quick commerce, pharmaceuticals, construction, electronics, chemicals, engineering, hospitality, and waste management industries. The company offers its products under the Nilkamal brand. Nilkamal Limited was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NIMBSPROJ.about: Nimbus Projects Limited engages in the development of real estate properties for residential, commercial, and retail purposes in India. The company develops townships, group housing, office spaces, commercial-shopping malls, and hotel projects. It is also involved in land identification and acquisition, project planning, designing, marketing and execution; project management; construction of properties; and provision of real estate consultancy, investment advisory, and construction services. The company was formerly known as NCJ International Limited and changed its name to Nimbus Projects Limited in December 2010. Nimbus Projects Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.

NINSYS.about: NINtec Systems Limited provides software development services and solutions in India. The company offers business analytics services; cloud services, including cloud infrastructure, and management; application engineering comprising web, mobile, and backend systems monoliths, microservices, event-driven architectures, and API-first platforms; testing services, such as functional testing, performance engineering, security testing, and accessibility.; and artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions. It also provides offshore software product development, software migration, and multimedia design services. In addition, the company provides blockchain services, such as enterprise blockchain platforms on hyperledger fabric and besu for supply chain, trade finance, and identity applications; internet of things; process automations; cognitive artificial intelligence; technology consulting services; outsourcing and digital services; and cyber security services. The company serves healthcare and life sciences, automotive and aftermarket, logistics and supply chain, fintech and banking, gaming and I gaming, media and entertainment, retail and e-commerce, pharmaceuticals, high tech and SaaS industries. NINtec Systems Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

NIRLON.about: Nirlon Limited engages in the development and management of an industrial/information technology park. The company's primary business activity is the development, management, and operation of Nirlon Knowledge Park (NKP), an approximately 23-acre campus located in Goregaon (East), Mumbai. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is based in Mumbai, India. Nirlon Limited operates as a subsidiary of Reco Berry Private Limited.

NITCO.about: NITCO Limited engages in the tiles and marble business in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Tiles and Related Products; and Real Estate. The company provides vitrified tiles, such as glazed, DCH, heavy duty and SST; wooden tiles, including wall, floor, ceramic and vitrified; ceramic wall and floor tiles; and digital, Italian, and porcelain tiles. It also offers anti-bacterial, anti-skid vitrified, anti-skid ceramic, as well as stain, scratch, and chemical resistance tiles. In addition, the company provides marble products; and is involved in the development of real estate properties. It sells its products under the Le Studio Express, NITCO Look brands. NITCO Limited was founded in 1953 and is based in Mumbai, India.

NITINSPIN.about: Nitin Spinners Limited manufactures and sells cotton and blended yarns, knitted fabrics, and finished woven fabrics in India and internationally. The company offers yarn products comprising cotton and poly/cotton blended, ring spun combed and carded, open end, compact, slub, core spun, multifold, twist, gassed, contamination free, and dye-able cheese/cones yarns, as well as yarn products made from Supima Giza, Organic, BCI cotton, and recycled fibres; and yarns with count range 6 to 100s. Its yarn products are used in woven and knitted apparel, tea bags, furnishing and medical fabrics, denims, and terry tow applications. The company also provides knitted fabrics, such as single jersey, lycra blended fabrics, pique and interlock structures, rib structures, 2T and 3T fleece fabrics, and open width with elastene for use in inner and comfort wear, sportswear, winterwear, and babywear applications. In addition, it offers finished and printed woven fabrics, including cotton spandex, poly/cotton spandex, RFD, bleached, dyed, print and yarn dyed, cotton viscose, and viscose and rayon fabrics; special finishes, such as teflon, wrinkle free, water repellant, nano care, soil release, anti-bacteria finish, aero finish, and bio polish; various weaves, which include twills, gabardines, broken twill, ripstop, canvas, mattie's, ducks, plain tussor, dobby, cord, and ottoman, etc.; and health and eco-friendly fabrics made from BCI/organic cotton. The company's finished and printed woven fabrics are used in fashion and image wear, uniforms, health care and hotel apparel, industrial and protective wear, and defense wear applications. It exports its products to approximately 55 countries. Nitin Spinners Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Bhilwara, India.

NITTAGELA.about: Nitta Gelatin India Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of ossein, gelatin, and collagen peptide in India and internationally. It offers wellnex collagen peptides for collagen peptide absorption, diabetes management, bones and joints, and beauty products; gelatin for pharmaceutical and edible applications; and Di Calcium Phosphate for use in poultry feed. The company provides chitosan for food, pharmaceutical, textile, agriculture, water treatment, and cosmetics industries, as well as ossein. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Kerala Chemicals & Proteins Limited and changed its name to Nitta Gelatin India Limited in 2008. Nitta Gelatin India Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Kochi, India.

NIVABUPA.about: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited provides health insurance products in India. It offers health insurance plans, such as individual, family, NRIs, senior citizens, personal accident, critical illness, disease-specific, hospital cash, and maternity insurance; travel insurance plans, including international and studying abroad insurance; and corporate insurance plans comprising group and start up health, group personal accident, and OPD coverage, as well as group health insurance claim process. The company was formerly known as Max Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited and changed its name to Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited in July 2021. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Gurugram, India. Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Bupa Singapore Holdings Pte. Ltd.

NLCINDIA.about: NLC India Limited engages in the mining and power generation business in India. It operates through three segments: Mining, PowerThermal, and Power  Renewab. The company mines for lignite and coal; and generates power through lignite and coal, as well as through thermal, solar, and wind power plants. It also operates open cast lignite mines with a mining capacity of 28.0 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) in Tamil Nadu and 30.10 MTPA in Rajasthan; and has total coal mining capacity of 20.00 MTPA. In addition, the company provides consultancy services to the mining sector and firms in the solar power generation sector. Further, it has a total installed thermal power generation capacity of 5,300 MW; and renewable energy generation capacity of 1,785 MW. It serves state distribution firms, commercial enterprises, and industrial and power consumers. The company was formerly known as Neyveli Lignite Corporation Limited and changed its name to NLC India Limited in April 2016. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Cuddalore, India.

NMDC.about: NMDC Limited, together with its subsidiaries, explores for and produces iron ore in India and internationally. It operates through Iron Ore, Trading of HR Coil, and All Other Segments (Pellets, Other Mineral, Products, Services & Others). The company also explores for lithium, copper, rock phosphate, limestone, beach sand, coking and non-coking coal, magnesite, diamond, tungsten, nickel, gold, base metals, and rare earth metals. In addition, it produces and sells hot rolled coil and pellets; and generates and distributes solar and wind power. The company exports its products. NMDC Limited was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

NOCIL.about: NOCIL Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of rubber chemicals for tire, automotive, rubber goods, and industrial sectors in India and internationally. It provides rubber chemicals, including pilflex, pilnox, pilcure, and pilgard, as well as anti-degradants/anti-oxidants accelerators. The company also offers technical services. NOCIL Limited was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NORTHARC.about: Northern Arc Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides lending and allied services in India. It operates through Financing Activity, Investment Advisory Services, and Investment Management Services segments. The company offers rural financing services; loans for personal, microfinance, vehicle finance, as well as buy now pay later solutions; education loans; insurance premium financing; MSME financing, MFI, consumer and vehicle finance, and housing and agriculture finance; rural financing; mid-market corporate lending, loans against property, and supply chain finance; and fund management services, including alternative investment funds and portfolio management services. It also provides debt products, such as term and working capital loans, non-convertible debentures, principal protected market linked debentures, commercial papers, external commercial borrowings, and sub-debt products; and credit-enhanced debt products, including guarantee-backed lending, single issuer partial credit enhanced, and pooled loan and bond issuance program. In addition, the company offers portfolio financing products comprising rated securitization, multi-originator microfinance securitization, persistent securitizations, and direct assignments. Further, it provides Altifi, an alternative retail debt investment platform; Nimbus, a curated debt platform that enables end-to-end processing of debt transactions; nPOS, a co-lending and co-origination technology solution; and NuScore, a customized machine learning based analytical module designed to assist in the loan underwriting process. It serves rural and retail customers; micro, small, and medium enterprises; originator partners; emerging corporates; and institutional investors. The company was formerly known as IFMR Capital Finance Limited and changed its name to Northern Arc Capital Limited in February 2018. Northern Arc Capital Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Chennai, India.

NOVARTIND.about: Evonile Pharma Limited is involved in the pharmaceutical business in India and internationally. It operates Pharma International (Commercial operations), Development (Drug development), Biomedical Research, and Operations. The company offers therapeutic products in the areas of bone and pain under the Voveran brand; transplantation immunology under the Simulect, Certican, Sandimmun, Neoral, and Myfortic brands. It also offers neuroscience products under the Tegrital and Exelon brands. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Mumbai, India. As of July 29, 2026, Evonile Pharma Limited operates as a subsidiary of Waverise Investments Limited.

NPST.about: Network People Services Technologies Limited develops banking and payments infrastructure for Banks and financial institutions, payment aggregators, and consumers in India. The company operates as a technology service provider (TSP) and payment platform-as-a-service (PPaaS) provider. It also offers online and offline transaction processing, banking super apps, fraud prevention, dispute management, and compliance technology. Network People Services Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Thane, India.

NRAIL.about: N R Agarwal Industries Limited manufactures and sells finished paper products in India. The company offers coated duplex boards, folding box board (FBB), and solid bleached sulphate (SBS) for offset printing, embossing, and foil stamping; writing and printing papers; copier papers; and newsprint products. Its products are primarily used in FMCG packaging, textbooks and notebooks, and print media sectors. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NRBBEARING.about: NRB Bearings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and trades in bearing products in India and internationally. It offers drawn cup needle, cylindrical roller, drawn cup cylindrical roller, full-complement needle, special ball, thrust, tapered and spherical roller, and rocker-arm bearings, as well as planetary shafts and other special pins, polyamide and steel needle bearing cages, crank pins, and formed strip cages for heavy gearboxes. The company also provides customer support services. Its products are used in mobility applications. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Mumbai, India.

NSDL.about: National Securities Depository Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides depository services in India. It operates through Depository, Database Management Services, and Banking Services segments. The company provides SPEED-e for demat account holders for direct online submission of instructions; IDeAS for viewing balances and transactions; SPICE for clearing members to submit instructions for the clients who have given power of attorney (POA) and to streamline auto pay-in instructions; and STeADY for brokers to deliver/submit electronic contract notes. It also offers value-added services comprising DPM plus, delivery instruction management system, STP navigator, auto download, and eSigner; digital integration products consisting of digital LAS, demat account validation, MF conversion and redemption APIs, eDIS and margin pledge, and open architecture system; and issuer service offerings, such as issuer companies, e-AGM, e-voting, tax services, direct payout mechanism, and reference data products, as well as online platforms for issuances, including CP issuance platform, issuer portal, security and covenant monitoring, system-driven disclosure, FPI monitor, and corporate bond database. In addition, the company provides account maintenance, dematerialization, rematerialization, and transmission/nomination; market, off market, and inter-depository transfers; depository account validation; consolidated account statement; auto delivery out; dividend distribution; and stock lending and borrowing services. Further, it is involved in electronic infrastructure for dematerialization of securities; facilitation of electronic settlement of trades; and set-up of system infrastructure, connectivity, software application, and database management systems. The company was formerly known as NSDL Depository Limited and changed its name to National Securities Depository Limited in January 2013. National Securities Depository Limited was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NSE.about: National Stock Exchange of India Limited, a stock exchange, provides an automated screen-based electronic trading system in India. The company operates through Trading Services, Clearing Services, and Others segments. It offers services related to trading in equities, equity derivatives, debt, currency derivatives, and commodity derivatives segments; clearing and settlement services for the trades executed in the capital markets, future and options, currency derivatives, and commodity derivatives segments; data feed services, data terminal services, strategic investments and index licensing services; indices and related products and services to various participants in the capital market; and services related to making or holding various strategic investments in the equity shares and other securities of various group companies. It also provides real-time market data, financial news, and analytics to institutional participants in the financial market; ESG ratings; web trading, information technology, IT process support, software application development, and information technology security services, as well as end to end and e-learning solutions. In addition, the company offers mutual funds, interest rate derivatives, fixed income and debt, public issues, and electronic gold receipts. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

NSIL.about: Nalwa Sons Investments Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the investment and financing business in India. The company operates through the Investment & Finance; and Trading of Goods segments. The company holds investments in equity shares of steel manufacturing companies of O.P. Jindal Group. The company was formerly known as Jindal Strips Limited and changed its name to Nalwa Sons Investments Limited. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is based in New Delhi, India.

NSLNISP.about: NMDC Steel Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India. The company offers hot rolled coils, sheets, and plates; structural steel; pig iron; and LPG cylinders, bridges, automobile, pipes, storage tanks, boilers, railway wagons and other structural steel products. It also provides tube and pipe grade, boiler and pressure vessel grade, commercial forming grades, cold rolling grade, and HSLA Grade. It serves infrastructure and construction; automotive and mobility; energy, oil, and gas; and engineering and fabrication industries. NMDC Steel Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

NTCIND.about: ntc industries limited manufactures and sells cigarettes and tobacco products in India. The company offers matchboxes under the Regent brand name and incense sticks under the Agardeep brand name. The company sells tobacco products under the Loose Tabacco, GENERAL, Carlton, Derby, GOLDMANS, MACPOLE, Jaipur, Maypole, FX AMERICAN BLEND, Aadie, VALENTINO, PATRONCITO, El Patron, DOS, DOS II, and ROYAL KING brands. In addition, the company offers flue-cured virginia tobacco, a virginia tobacco or bright leaf. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as RDB Industries Ltd and changed its name to ntc industries limited in March 2011. ntc industries limited was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

NTPC.about: NTPC Limited operates as an integrated power company in India and Mauritius. It operates through two segments: Generation and Others. The company generates power from fossil fuels, hydro, solar, wind, nuclear, and renewable energy sources. It also engages in the coal mining and energy trading business. NTPC Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is based in New Delhi, India.

NTPCGREEN.about: NTPC Green Energy Limited engages in the renewable energy generation business in India. The company has a portfolio of 26,544 MWs solar and wind power projects. It also offers consultancy services, project management, and supervision services. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in New Delhi, India. NTPC Green Energy Limited is a subsidiary of NTPC Limited.

NUCLEUS.about: Nucleus Software Exports Limited provides lending and transaction banking products to the financial services industry in India, the Far East, South East Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Australia, and internationally. It offers FinnOne Neo, a next-generation digital lending platform for intelligent, scalable, and customer-centric lending ecosystems; and FinnAxia, an integrated global transaction banking platform for payments, liquidity management, cash management, and corporate banking operations; and Nucleus Software Digital Services. The company also offers nucleus software digital services. In addition, it provides testing, consulting, application development, maintenance, and infrastructure management services. Nucleus Software Exports Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

NUVAMA.about: Nuvama Wealth Management Limited engages in wealth management, asset management and services, and capital markets businesses in India and internationally. It operates through wealth management, asset management, and capital markets segments. The company offers financial products, investment advisory, lending against securities and securities broking services; investment management services for alternative investment funds; and portfolio management services. It is also involved in the institutional broking and merchant banking businesses, as well as provision of advisory and clearing services. The company was formerly known as Edelweiss Securities Limited and changed its name to Nuvama Wealth Management Limited in August 2022. Nuvama Wealth Management Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India. Nuvama Wealth Management Limited operates as a subsidiary of PAGAC Ecstasy Pte. Ltd.

NUVOCO.about: Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited manufactures and sale of cement and building materials products in India. It operates through Cement, and RMX and Other divisions. The company offers ordinary Portland, Portland slag, Portland pozzolana, and Portland composite cement products under the Concreto Uno, Duraguard, Double Bull, PSC, Nirmax, and Infracem brands; and ready-mix concrete under the Concreto, Ecodure, Artiste, InstaMix, and X-Con brands. It also provides modern building materials, including construction chemicals, multipurpose bonding and waterproofing agents, tile and stone adhesives, tile grouts, ready-mix dry plaster, block joining mortar, dry bag concrete, and cover blocks products under the Zero M brands. The company was formerly known as Lafarge India Limited and changed its name to Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited in April 2017. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Nuvoco Vistas Corporation Limited is a subsidiary of Niyogi Enterprise Private Limited.

NWIL.about: Nurture Well Industries Limited trades in food products in India and internationally. The company provides various biscuits and cookies under the Richlite, Funtreat, CANBERRA, and Crunchy Kraze brands; glucose; borbon, butter, cashew, coconut, cream, digestive, glucobite, marie, milk, puff, glucose, and sweet and salty, as well as engages in the business of organic and inorganic foods products, bakery products, and other processed foods items. The company was formerly known as Integrated Industries Limited and changed its name to Nurture Well Industries Limited in January 2026. Nurture Well Industries Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Noida, India.

NYKAA.about: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Limited, through its subsidiaries, manufactures, sells, and distributes beauty and lifestyle products in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Beauty, Fashion, and Others. The company offers makeup for face, eyes, lips, and nails, as well as makeup palettes and tools and brushes; body, eye lip, sun, and hands and feet care products, as well as moisturizers, serums, cleansers, masks, toners, skin tools and supplements, neck creams, Korean beauty products, and specialized skincare; hair care and styling products, as well as tools and accessories; appliances; bath and shower, feminine hygiene, female and male grooming products, hygiene essentials, and oral care; and natural products. It also provides diaper essentials, baby accessories and hygiene, nursing and feeding items, and products for moms; health and wellness, including beauty boosters, daily nutrition, mind and mood, fitness and recovery, intimate wellness, herbal and ayurvedic, and women's health products; men essentials; fragrances; and lingerie, watches, sunglasses, bags, footwear, jewellery, and home essentials. In addition, the company offers marketing support services. It sells its products under various brand names through online portals or websites, such as e-commerce, m-commerce, internet, and intranet, as well as physical stores, stalls, and general and modern trade. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Mumbai, India.

OAL.about: Oriental Aromatics Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells fragrances, flavours, specialty aroma ingredients, and camphor and terpene chemicals in India. The company offers flavours and fragrances for use in beverages, oral hygiene, sweets, instant foods, dairy products, incense sticks, fine fragrances, personal care, and home care; specialty aroma ingredient for fragrance compounds, flavour formulations, personal care, home care, fine fragrances, cosmetics, and other aroma-led consumer applications; and camphor and terpene chemicals for puja and devotional, household applications, pain-relief products, topical formulations, pharmaceutical preparations, and flavours. It also exports its products to Egypt, Kenya, Morocco, South Africa, Zambia, Bangladesh, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Israel, Japan, Lebanon, Malaysia, Nepal, Oman, Singapore, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Turkey, the United Arab Emirates, Vietnam, Yemen, Austria, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain, Switzerland, Turkey, the United Kingdom, Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Canada, Mexico, and the United States. The company serves various customers, including FMCG, personal care, home care, food, pharma, pain management, and devotional product categories. The company was formerly known as Camphor & Allied Products Limited and changed its name to Oriental Aromatics Limited in February 2018. Oriental Aromatics Limited was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

OBEROIRLTY.about: Oberoi Realty Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development business in India. The company operates through the Real Estate and the Hospitality segment. It develops and sells residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, and social infrastructure projects. The company also leases commercial properties; and owns and operates a hotel. In addition, it engages in the sale of rooms, food and beverages, and allied services related to hotel operations, as well as in the provision of property management services. Oberoi Realty Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

OCCLLTD.about: OCCL Limited manufactures and sells insoluble sulphur in India. The company also offers commercial grade and battery grade sulphuric acid and oleums for use as a dehydrating agent, and catalyst and active reactant in chemical processes, solvents, and absorbents. It markets its products to approximately 25 countries. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Noida, India. OCCL Limited is a subsidiary of Oriental Carbon & Chemicals Limited.

ODYCORP.about: Odyssey Corporation Limited engages in trading activities in India. It is also involved in the production of feature films; organization of events; selling, sourcing, shipping, and financing activities; and mining activities. In addition, the company offers non-banking financial services. The company was formerly known as Odyssey Financial Services Limited and changed its name to Odyssey Corporation Limited in October 2000. Odyssey Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.

OFSS.about: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) solutions to the financial services industry worldwide. It operates in two segments, Product Licenses and Related Activities; and IT Solutions and Consulting Services. The company offers Oracle FLEXCUBE; Oracle FLEXCUBE Investor Servicing; Oracle Banking Digital Experience; Oracle Financial Services Lending and Leasing; and Oracle Banking APIs. It also provides Oracle FLEXCUBE Universal Banking; Oracle Banking Platform; Oracle Banking Enterprise Limits and Collateral Management; Oracle FLEXCUBE for Islamic banking and microfinance; Oracle Banking Branch; Oracle Banking Origination; Oracle Banking Cash Management; Oracle Banking Liquidity Management; Oracle Banking Corporate Lending; Oracle Banking Supply Chain Finance; Oracle Banking Trade Finance; Oracle Banking Treasury Management; Oracle Banking Virtual Accounts Management; Oracle Banking Payments; and Oracle Banking Credit Facilities Process Management, as well as Asset Finance, Oracle Banking Collections and Recovery, and Oracle Documaker solutions. In addition, the company offers Oracle Financial Services Data Management Solutions, as well as cloud infrastructure, risk and finance, human capital management, and data management for financial services; and bancassurance solutions. Further, it provides a suite of industry applications catering to the areas of risk, finance, treasury, front office, regulatory reporting, and compliance; and Oracle Finergy that enables financial services enterprises to drive simplicity using technology, as well as consulting and business process services business. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Oracle Financial Services Software Limited operates as a subsidiary of Oracle Global (Mauritius) Limited.

OIL.about: Oil India Limited engages in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas in India. It operates through Crude Oil, Natural Gas, LPG, Pipeline Transportation, Renewable Energy, and Others segments. The company owns and operates crude oil trunk pipeline comprising an area of 1,157 kilometers; and drilling rigs and workover rigs. It is also involved in the transportation of crude oil and natural gas; and production of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) and condensate, as well as in the pipeline transportation services. In addition, it generates energy through wind and solar power projects. Oil India Limited was founded in 1889 and is based in Noida, India.

OLAELEC.about: Ola Electric Mobility Limited develops, manufactures, and sells electric vehicles in India. It operates through the Automotive and Cell segments. The company provides electric scooters; and electric vehicle components, such as battery packs, motors and vehicle frames, and cells. It also operates charging stations and service centers. Ola Electric Mobility Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

OLECTRA.about: Olectra Greentech Limited manufactures and sells electric buses and trucks in India. It operates in two segments, Energy Division and Mobility Division. The company offers electric tippers. It also provides 1200KV, 330-420KV, 220-245KV, 110-132KV, 52-77KV, 33-36KV, 22-28KV, and 10-15KV composite polymer insulators for transmission and distribution; and tonne, bracket tube, and stay arm insulators for railways. The company serves state and central government bodies, and power generation and distribution utilities; private power generation companies; and multinational infrastructure companies. The company was formerly known as Goldstone Infratech Limited and changed its name to Olectra Greentech Limited in July 2018. Olectra Greentech Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

OMAXE.about: Omaxe Limited engages in real estate development activities in India. Its portfolio includes residential, commercial, retail and integrated township projects, as well as group housing, SCOs, shopping malls, and hotels. The company was formerly known as Omaxe Construction Limited and changed its name to Omaxe Limited in June 2006. Omaxe Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India. Omaxe Limited operates as a subsidiary of Guild Builders Private Limited.

OMFREIGHT.about: Om Freight Forwarders Limited provides logistics and allied services through sea, road, rail, and air in India. It offers customs clearance; international air and sea freight forwarding; charter services; project logistics; nominated cargo; bonded trucking and trans shipping; port and vessel handling; road transportation; inventory warehousing and distribution; third country export cross trade; post shipment activities; export import DGFT licensing; and value added services. Om Freight Forwarders Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

OMINFRAL.about: Om Infra Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, detail engineering, manufacture, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of hydro mechanical equipment for hydroelectric power and irrigation projects in India and internationally. It operates through Engineering, Real Estate, and Road segments. The company offers heavy radial gates, penstocks, and hydraulic hoists. It is also involved in designing, manufacturing, supplying, installation, and commissioning of critical hydro-mechanical equipment such as gates, hoists, cranes, and spillways; construction and rehabilitation of dams, canals, lift irrigation systems, and pumping stations; and construction of pipelines, pumping stations, overhead reservoirs, and water treatment plants, as well as develops residential and commercial units. In addition, the company engages in providing civil and hydro-mechanical irrigation solutions; and hotel business activities. The company was formerly known as Om Metals Infraprojects Limited and changed its name to Om Infra Limited in January 2021. Om Infra Limited was founded in 1969 and is based in New Delhi, India.

OMNI.about: Omnitech Engineering Limited engages in the manufacturing and supply of engineered components and assemblies worldwide. The company offers drilling, exploration, and refining products for upstream, midstream, and downstream applications, as well as braking systems, drive systems, and pumping units for renewable energy, electricity generation, and power production. It also provides actuator systems, motion control and drive technologies, robotic systems, and conveying and handling systems; crushing and screening systems, conveying solutions, drilling and blasting equipment, surface and underground rig components, and core drilling equipment for mining and earth moving equipment; and valve components for gas and stream equipment. In addition, the company offers hydraulic and pneumatic systems for airport ground support operations and heavy-duty industrial equipment. Omnitech Engineering Limited was founded in 2006 and is based in Rajkot, India.

OMPOWER.about: Om Power Transmission Limited, an engineering, procurement, and construction company, executes high-voltage and extra-high voltage transmission line, substations, and underground cabling projects. The company constructs transmission lines of voltage levels; undertakes high tension and low tension underground cabling providing services, such as trenching, cable laying, jointing, and termination; and offers substation projects comprising design, supply, erection, testing, commissioning, and civil works for conventional and renewable energy evacuation substations. It also provides operation and maintenance services for substations and transmission lines. The company serves utilities, renewable energy developers, and industrial customers. Om Power Transmission Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

ONEGLOBAL.about: One Global Service Provider Limited engages in the provision of healthcare services worldwide. The company offers diagnostic services, including anemia, antenatal, diabetes, diabetes monitoring, hypertension, kidney, and lipid profiles, as well as liver function tests; and healthcare services, such as end-to-end solutions in industrial occupational check-ups, population screening for non-communicable diseases, disease surveillance programs, electronic medical records and health registry, health analytics for predictive and preventive actions, and wellness programs for lifestyle diseases. It also provides laboratory services, such as biochemistry, microbiology, hematology and coagulation, histopathology and cytopathology, clinical pathology, molecular diagnostics, and serology. In addition, the company offers healthcare products, such as medical devices, equipment, medical consumables, and reagents through an online platform; and healthcare solutions comprising home-based health screening, public health data analytics, and home-based remote care services. Further, it involves in consultancy and development, requirements, designs, develops, tests, integrates, deploys, and maintains software/IT products; and purchases, sells, distributes licenses, resells, imports, exports IT and/or software products. The company was formerly known as Overseas Synthetics Limited. One Global Service Provider Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.

ONEPOINT.about: One Point One Solutions Limited engages in the customer life cycle management, business process management, and technology servicing activities in India. The company provides customer experience management services, including omnichannel, multilingual customer support across email, chat, voice and digital platforms; digital transformation and automation services; finance and accounting outsourcing services comprising payroll management, budgeting, bookkeeping, forecasting, and compliance services; trust and safety services that include fraud detection, user-generated content, moderation, and brand review content moderation and review; supply chain and operations management; creator economy support services, such as brand partnerships, content production, audience growth, and IP management; and medical records and litigation support services. It serves banking and financial, telecom, insurance, airlines, consumer durables, FMCG, retail, e-commerce, travel, and hospitality industries. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.

ONESOURCE.about: OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and commercialization of biological drug products in various injectable formats in India, Singapore, the United States, Spain, and internationally. The company provides end-to-end contract development and manufacturing operations (CDMO) services across various phases of pre-clinical and clinical development and commercial supply of biologics. It also offers drug-devices, including prefilled syringes, dial and push variable and fixed dose pen injectors, pull push fixed pens, and autoinjectors and self-administration platforms; sterile injectables; soft gelatin capsules; and biologics solutions for recombinant proteins, monoclonal antibodies and biosimilars, cell and gene therapy, and RNA products. The company was formerly known as Stelis Biopharma Limited and changed its name to OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited in February 2024. OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

ONGC.about: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil, natural gas, and value-added products in India and internationally. It operates through Exploration and Production, Refining & Marketing, and Petrochemicals segments. The company offers LPG, naptha, ethane, propane and butane, superior kerosene oil, LSHS, high-speed diesel, aviation turbine fuel, liquefied petroleum gas, light diesel oil, MTO, and other products. It also engages in the refining and marketing of petroleum products; provision of petrochemicals, as well as helicopter services; power generation; LNG supply; pipeline transportation; SEZ development; manufacturing of ethanol and sugar; green and renewable energy business; and operating and chartering of fleets. The company also exports its products. Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited was founded in 1955 and is based in New Delhi, India.

ONIDA.about: Onida Electronics Limited engages in manufacturing and trading of electronics and consumer durables in India. The company offers mini-LED, karaoke, QLED, 4K Ultra HD, Full HD, and HD ready televisions; inverter and fixed air conditioners; mobile phone; LED light speaker system; HD media player; and home appliances, such as washing machines, washers, refrigerators, and air coolers under the Onida brand. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as MIRC Electronics Limited and changed its name to Onida Electronics Limited in May 2026. Onida Electronics Limited incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India.

ONIXSOLAR.about: Onix Solar Energy Limited a renewable energy company, engages in the solar module manufacturing and renewable energy in India. The company holds solar module manufacturing capacity of up to 800 MW; Onix Solar Energy produces high-efficiency N-Type TOPCon and P-Type modules ranging from 530 Wp to 640 Wp. It also develops 1000 MW of solar projects across Maharashtra. The company was formerly known as ABC Gas (International) Limited and changed its name to Onix Solar Energy Limited in October 2024. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

OPTIEMUS.about: Optiemus Infracom Limited, together with its subsidiaries, trades in mobile handset and mobile accessories in India and internationally. The company offers electronic products like mobile phones, hearables & wearables, telecom products, IOT devices, modules, PCBA, cameras, and other products, as well as trading and distribution of electronics goods and drones. It markets its products under Optisafe, Zen, Kult, and BlackBerry brand names. The company was formerly known as Akanksha Cellular Limited and changed its name to Optiemus Infracom Limited in June 2011. Optiemus Infracom Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Noida, India.

OPTIFIN.about: Optimus Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the financing and investment activities in India. The company operates in two segments, Financing and Investment activities, and Trading of Chemicals. It primarily invests in shares and securities, as well as other investments. The company manufactures, distributes, and trades in lubricant oils, base oils, and other petro-chemical products for use in the automotive, metal working, refrigeration, electrical, paint, and ink industries. Optimus Finance Limited was formerly known as Transpek Finance Limited and changed its name to Optimus Finance Limited in September 2015. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Vadodara, India. Optimus Finance Limited is a subsidiary of Sukruti Infratech Private Limited.

ORCHPHARMA.about: Orchid Pharma Limited, a pharmaceutical company, engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of active pharmaceutical ingredients, bulk actives, finished dosage formulations, and nutraceuticals in India. Its active pharmaceutical ingredients product portfolio includes oral cephalosporins, injectable cephalosporins; human and veterinary products; and antibiotics, including beta-lactam. It serves pharma companies, generic drug manufacturers, healthcare distributors, and institutional and government buyers. The company also exports its products to approximately 40 countries internationally. It has a strategic collaboration with Cipla for marketing across India. The company was formerly known as Orchid Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Limited and changed its name to Orchid Pharma Limited in October 2015. Orchid Pharma Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

ORICONENT.about: Oricon Enterprises Limited engages in trading and real estate businesses in India and internationally. It is also involved in trading, real estate, warehousing, and shipping and related logistics businesses. The company was formerly known as Oriental Containers Ltd. Oricon Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Mumbai, India.

ORIENTCABL.about: Orient Cables (India) Limited engages in the manufacturing of networking cables and passive networking equipment. The company operates through three segments, Networking Cables and Solutions, that includes AT5, CAT 5e, CAT6 and CAT6A cables and its variants. It also manufactures networking cable terminated assemblies with connectors and specialty glands, and CCTV and Coaxial Cables through this segment; Specialty Power, Optical Fibre Cable and Solutions, which manufactures power cables, such as low-tension power cables and terminated power assemblies with special power cable connectors used in telecom infrastructure, optical fibre cables in the unitube and multitube categories, and terminated assemblies featuring standard and specialized connectors. Additionally, it produces KNX cables for home and office automation, as well as lift cables used in elevators; and Other Allied Products, in this segment, the company manufactures products related to the passive cable ecosystem catering to industries including broadband, telecom, data centres, renewable energy, smart building automation/ security, system integration, FMEG and automotives. The company manufactures products for telecommunication service providers, or multi-national companies engaged in developing and supplying networking and connectivity products, providers of IT solutions, and data centres. The company exports products to overseas customers located in UAE, Qatar, USA, Australia, New Zealand, Nepal, Singapore and Netherlands. Orient Cables (India) Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Gurugram, India.

ORIENTCEM.about: Orient Cement Limited manufactures and sells cement in India. The company offers pozzolana and ordinary Portland cement under the Birla A1 Premium Cement, Birla A1 StrongCrete, Birla A1 OrientGreen, and Birla A1 Dolphin brand names. Its products are used in residential, commercial, infrastructure, industrial, and community projects. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Ahmedabad, India. Orient Cement Limited operates as a subsidiary of Ambuja Cements Limited.

ORIENTELEC.about: Orient Electric Limited manufactures, purchases, and sells lifestyle electrical products in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Electrical Consumer Durables, and Lighting and Switchgear. The company offers table, stand, wall, lifestyle, exhaust, personal, and silent fans; ceiling fans, including BLDC, high speed, smart, under light, remote controllable, and chandelier fans; mixer and juicer mixer grinders, electric kettles, room heaters, coffee machines, stand mixers, irons, and induction cooktops; desert, tower, personal, window, industrial, and portable coolers; and storage, instant, immersion water heaters. It also provides retail lighting products, such as ceiling, wall, outdoor, and decorative lights, as well as LED bulbs; LED consumer luminaries comprising LED strip lights, street lights, spot lights, panels, flood lights, down lighters, and battens, as well as desk lamps; LED lamps and tubes; switchgears, which include multi and smart plugs, plug tops, extension and distribution boards, door bells, MCBs, RCCBs, isolators, sockets, lamp holders, switches, and other switch and switchgear products; and flame retardant wires and communication cables. The company sells its products under the DE'Longhi and Kenwood brand names through retail outlets, digital, and project-led channels. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1939 and is based in New Delhi, India.

ORIENTHOT.about: Oriental Hotels Limited owns, operates, and manages hotels and resorts in India and Hong Kong. The company's hotel portfolio includes the Taj Coromandel, Chennai; Taj Fisherman's Cove Resort & Spa, Chennai; Taj Malabar Resort & Spa, Cochin; Vivanta, Coimbatore; Gateway Madurai and Coonoor; and Vivanta, Mangalore. It provides accommodation, restaurant, food, and catering services. Oriental Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Chennai, India.

ORIENTTECH.about: Orient Technologies Limited provides information technology services in India and internationally. It operates through IT Infrastructure Solutions; and IT Infrastructure and Application Services segments. The company provides IT infrastructure and technology services, such as infrastructure design, systems integration, data centres, cloud, hyperconverged infrastructure, software defined wide area networking, software-defined storage and virtual desktop infrastructure solutions. It also offers IaaS, PaaS, FaaS, DBaaS, storage as a service, as well as network as a service, security as a service, backup as a service, monitoring as a service, software as a service, content delivery network, and serverless computing solutions; and enterprise IT services, including infrastructure managed, break fix, managed print, cloud computing, systems integration, and applications development and maintenance services. In addition, the company provides managed services, such as monitoring, maintenance, and support of IT systems; multi vendor support; network operations centre services; and renewals of software licenses. Further, it offers data centre solutions that include servers, storage, active, and passive networking components; collaboration solutions for CCTV, virtual conferences, and meetings; and security solutions; as well as hyper converged infrastructure; virtualization solutions; and end-user computing that include desktop management, end-user support, and mobile device management. It serves BFSI, media, communication, healthcare, ITeS, manufacturing, government, infrastructure, real estate, logistics, education, e-commerce, conglomerates, energy, and service industries. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

ORIRAIL.about: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Limited manufactures, buys, and sells various recron, seats and berths, and compreg board products in India and internationally. The company also provides compreg wood sheets used in electrical insulation, which include rings, blocks, and segments, etc.; silicon foam blocks and shuttering plates used in the manufacturing of seats and berths for railway coaches; acosonic boards used for architectural, thermal, and noise barriers solutions, as well as turnkey projects; lavatory doors; phenolic resins and hardners for plywood and moulded goods industries; artificial leather/rexine products under ORVIN brand used in shoes, automotive seating, commercial and residential upholstery, stationery, luggage and bags, and industrial and consumer applications; heavy equipment engineering, such as railway rolling stocks; and bogies, couplers, draft gears, and wagons. In addition, the company trades in timber woods, ferrous and non-ferrous metals, casting tools, slabs, rods, section flates, and other ferrous and non-ferrous products. Further, it exports its products. The company serves railways and other industries. The company was formerly known as Oriental Veneer Products Limited and changed its name to Oriental Rail Infrastructure Limited in March 2022. Oriental Rail Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.

ORISSAMINE.about: The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited mines and markets iron ore and manganese ore in India. It produces and sells sponge iron. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Bhubaneswar, India. The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited is a subsidiary of Eastern Investments Limited.

ORKLAINDIA.about: Orkla India Limited operates as a food company, manufactures and sells spices and convenience foods in India and internationally. It offers instant food mixes, spices, masalas and blended curry powders; ready-to-eat food products, vermicelli, confectionery, beverages, coffee; and rice products, such as Puttu Podi, Idli Podi, Dosa Podi, Pathiri Podi, Appam Podi, and other products. The company also provides spices, pickles, tea, tamarind, coconut oil, and oral care products. It sells its products through e-commerce websites and commerce platform under the MTR, Eastern, Rasoi Magic, Wok N Roll, and Laban brand names. The company was formerly known as MTR Foods Private Limited. The company was founded in 1924 and is based in Bengaluru, India. Orkla India Limited is a subsidiary of Orkla Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd.

OSWALPUMPS.about: Oswal Pumps Limited manufactures and sells solar pumps in India and internationally. The company offers solar-powered and grid-connected submersible and monoblock pumps, electric motors, accessories, pump control, control panel, and solar modules under the Oswal brand. It also offers sewage pumps, submersible winding wires and cables, and electrical panels. The company also serves agricultural, residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. In addition, it exports its products to Australia, Bangladesh, Cyprus, the United Arab Emirates, the United States of America, Germany, Saudi Arabia, Italy, and the United Kingdom. Oswal Pumps Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Karnal, India.

PACEDIGITK.about: Pace Digitek Limited operates as a service providers in power management, optic fiber laying, and energy management solutions in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Telecom, Energy, and Others. The company offers telecom power solutions include power management solutions, such as switch mode power supply, power management unit, integrated power management unit, hybrid DC power system; solar solutions, including charge control unit, inverters, power boosters, AC-DC converters and remote monitoring, and management solutions; battery energy storage solutions, such as lithium-ion battery systems, containerized BESS integration, power conversion systems, energy management systems, monitoring and analytics, and energy control platforms. It also engages in telecom, energy, ICT, and smart infrastructure, as well as provides lifecycle services. The company serves telecom network operators and tower infrastructure providers, state electricity boards and power distribution utilities, electricity generation companies, and private B2B customers in industrial, commercial, and EPC segments. Pace Digitek Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

PACIFICI.about: Pacific Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and trading of granite tiles and slabs, and quartz slabs in India. The company also provides marbles. In addition, it is involved in trading activities; and investment and finance businesses, as well as provision of other goods and commissioning and mining activities. The company also exports its products. Pacific Industries Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Udaipur, India.

PAGEIND.about: Page Industries Limited manufactures, markets, and distributes textile garments and clothing accessories for men, women, and kids in India and internationally. It offers vests, briefs, boxer briefs, trunks, inner boxers, tank tops, t-shirts, polos, oversized T-shirts, knit shirts, henleys, sweatshirts, jackets, hoodies, windcheater, boxer shorts, shorts, bermudas, joggers, track pants, pyjamas, pants, bras, panties, crop tops, camisoles, kurta slips, shrugs, sleep dresses, skirts, shorts, capris, culottes, leggings, shapewears, sets, caps, handkerchief, and masks; face, hand, bath, and gym towels; calf, ankle, knee, low show, and no show socks; and thermals under the Jockey brand. The company also has license with swim wear Speedo brand. Page Industries Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

PAISALO.about: Paisalo Digital Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in providing loans through its financial products in India. It offers small income generation loans, including Umeed loans, Pragati loans, and Vikas loans for self-employed individuals and small business owners in rural and semi-urban areas, supporting sectors like agriculture, retail, and handicrafts. The company also provides mobility loans, such as Gati loans for auto and electric rickshaw drivers, Raftaar loans for small vehicle owners, Do Ka Dum loans for two-wheeler purchase, and Ready Steady Go loans to purchase pre-owned cars; and entrepreneurial loans, including Udaan loans to empower entrepreneurs for business growth and expansion for commercial vehicles, used cars, two-wheelers, three-wheelers, agricultural equipment, and medical equipment. In addition, it provides SME and MSME loans, and corporate loans across the manufacturing, services, and trading sectors. The company was formerly known as S. E. Investments Limited and changed its name to Paisalo Digital Limited in January 2018. Paisalo Digital Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Agra, India.

PANACEABIO.about: Panacea Biotec Limited, a biotechnology company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and marketing of vaccines, pharmaceutical formulations, nutraceuticals, and food and nutrition products in India and internationally. The company operates through Vaccines and Pharmaceutical Formulations & Nutrition segments. Its product portfolio includes prescription products in various therapeutic areas, such as diabetes, gastro-intestinal care, nephrology, oncology, orthopedics, pain management, and fever; cold and cough; and betacoronavirus, SARS-CoV-2, typhoid conjugate, pneumococcal conjugate, tetravalent dengue, and Mpox, etc. The company also offers health supplement products; and nutrition products under the ChilRun full, ChilRun 7+, and ChillRun No Sucrose brands. In addition, it engages in the real estate business. It exports its products to approximately 50 countries. It has collaboration agreements with the Russian Direct Investment Fund for producing Covid-19 vaccine, and Sputnik-V; and the Indian Council of Medical Research for clinical trials of DengiAll vaccine. Panacea Biotec Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in New Delhi, India.

PANAMAPET.about: Panama Petrochem Limited, together with its subsidiary, Panol Industries RMC FZE, manufactures, sells, and trades in specialty petroleum products for the printing, textiles, rubber, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, power, and other industrial oil industries in India and internationally. The company offers white/liquid paraffin oil products comprising cosmetic-grade, food-grade, and pharmaceutical-grade white oil products; petroleum jelly products consisting of pharmaceutical creams, red veterinary petroleum, and cosmetics and lotions; transformer oils; ink and coating oils, including petroleum and aroma-free distillates, naphthenic and high viscosity oils, black ink oils, bituminous black varnishes, petrolatum, and low aromatic white spirits under the PANOL brand; and rubber process oils. It also provides textile oils, including Panol-KNT and antistatic coning oils; industrial oils, including compressor oils, long-life turbine and refrigeration oils, metal working fluids, marine oils, glass mold and quenching oils, thermic fluids, hydraulic oils, and wire drawing compounds; industrial and automotive greases, such as lithium and lithium complex, calcium and sodium-based, and aluminum greases; automotive engine, gear, and transmission oils, as well as other automotive lubricants; drilling fluids; and fully and semi-refined paraffin, and slack and micro waxes. The company exports its products to approximately 55 countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Middle East, Australia, the African sub-continent, and Southeast Asia. Panama Petrochem Limited was founded in 1975 and is based in Mumbai, India.

PANCHMAHQ.about: Panchmahal Steel Limited manufactures and sells stainless steel long products in the form of wire rods, bars, and wires in India and internationally. It offers stainless steel wire rods; cold finished bars for precise engineering; and bars for free machining. The company also provides wires for braiding, weaving, knitting, filters, springs, and ball making, as well as for cold heading and fasteners; heat resistant wires; EPQ wires; fine wires; core wires in coils and cut length; and TIG, MIG, and SAW filler wires. Its products are used in engineering, construction and infrastructure, automotive and railways, oil and gas, defense, energy, consumer durables, food processing and dairy, housing, and pharmaceutical industries. Panchmahal Steel Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Vadodara, India. Panchmahal Steel Limited is a subsidiary of Honeyvick Enterprises Private Limited.

PANORAMA.about: Panorama Studios International Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and distribution of media entertainment and content in India. It offers film production, project development, post production, film distribution, music, talent management, equipment rental, publicity and design, syndication, and line production services. The company was formerly known as Apunka Invest Commercial Limited. Panorama Studios International Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Mumbai, India.

PARACABLES.about: Paramount Communications Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of wires and cables in India. The company provides power cables, including high tension and low-tension power and aerial bunch, screened and unscreened cables, control cables, instrumentation cables, and certified cables for housing and renewables; railways cables comprising signaling, railway power, and axle counter cables; and telecom cables, such as optical fiber, jelly filled, buried service wire, fiber to home, switched board, and CATV cables, as well as jumper wires. It also offers special cables, which include PV solar, PTFE, fire survival cables, cables for electric vehicle battery charging stations, thermocouple, covered conductors, medium voltage covered conductors, and HTLS conductor; and domestic wires and cables, including building wires, multicore, submersible, coaxial and LAN cables. In addition, the company provides turnkey services, such as OPGW and submarine cable installation and repair; EPC services; telecom consultancy and turnkey; and power and railway turnkey projects. It serves power, solar & renewable energy, oil & gas, data centers, industrial and infrastructure projects, defence, space, construction, railways, and telecom sectors. The company also exports its products. Paramount Communications Limited was founded in 1955 and is based in New Delhi, India.

PARADEEP.about: Paradeep Phosphates Limited manufactures, trades, distributes, and sells urea and complex fertilizers in India. It sells its products through dealers and retailers under the Navratna and Jai Kisaan and Mangala brand names. The company offers di-ammonium phosphate; nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium fertilizers; muriate of potash; triple super phosphate; zypmite; phospho-gypsum; sulphuric acid; hydrofluorosilicic acid; and ammonia; as well as sulphur and zinc. It sells its products through dealers and retailers under the Navratna and Jai Kisaan and Mangala brand names. Paradeep Phosphates Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Bengaluru, India. The company operates as a subsidiary of Zuari Maroc Phosphates Private Limited.

PARAGMILK.about: Parag Milk Foods Limited processes, manufactures, and sells milk and milk products in India and internationally. The company offers ghee, milk, paneer, sweets, curd, butter, dairy whitener, milk powder, and gulab jamun mix products. It also offers flavoured cheese wedges, spreads, slices, and angles, as well as flavoured and fruit yoghurt, bocconcini, slim milk, fresh cream, buttermilk, double toned milk, lassi, flavoured milk, milk shakes, beverages, UHT milk, and other dairy products. In addition, the company provides sports nutrition products, whey protein, protein bar, chikki, and lactose related products. Further, it sells its products under the Gowardhan, Go, Topp Up, Pride of Cows, and Avvatar brand names. Parag Milk Foods Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Pune, India.

PARAS.about: Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and tests defense and space engineering products and solutions in India and internationally. The company offers rugged networking and communication, rugged display and computing, and rugged command and control systems; mechanical products, including flow formed tubes; and avionic suites, as well as automated test equipment. It also provides diffractive gratings, Zerodur and metal mirrors, optical domes, gyro blocks, multifold and IR lenses, reflectors and coatings, deployable space antennas, CFRP structures for space applications, lens barrels, and ultra-precision manufacturing products; and rugged wired cabinets, shielded doors, honey comb air vents/filters, command and control console/systems, naval electronic time fuse, acoustic and magnetic sensing products, naval chart, other software modules, turnkey indigo simulator systems, transducer positioning systems and platforms, submarine winches, and titanium assemblies. In addition, It provides high performance embedded computing systems, substitution sub-systems, tank imaging components and sub-assemblies, turret stabilization systems, rugged tri-pods and quadri-pods, ARRV winch systems, and red dot reflex sight products; and heavy duty antenna mechanical structures, rugged COTS systems, data/video/image processing systems, rugged VME/VPX platforms, and active array radar cooling assemblies, as well as software development and system integration services. Additionally, it offers Electro-Magnetic Pulse shielded rooms and control centers, racks and cabinets, shielded doors, anechoic shielded chambers, EMP filters, shielded air vents and windows, EMP hardened products, and turnkey EMP projects. The company was formerly known as Paras Flowform Engineering Limited and changed its name to Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited. Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India

PARIN.about: Parin Enterprises Limited engages in the manufacture, supply, and trade of furniture and lifestyle products in India. It offers health care furniture, such as accessories, general ward care and gynaec solutions, over bed/cardiac table, patient examination solution, saline stand, smart patient transfer solutions, stools, wheelchairs, ICU full and semi motorized beds, ICU manual beds, and trolleys; educational furniture, including school benches; and institute furniture, which includes door cabinets, open self-book cabinets, and filling lockers. The company also provides office furniture; public seating furniture; and cafeteria furniture comprising cafe tables and chairs. In addition, it offers household furniture, such as sofa-sets, dining tables with chairs, center tables, motorized and non-motorized recliner chairs, etc. Further, the company engages in the operations of dealing in trading of FMCG products; and dealership operations for motor vehicles, including sale of automobiles, spare parts, accessories, and services. It serves government, retail, and institutional customers. The company was formerly known as Parin Furniture Limited and changed its name to Parin Enterprises Limited in October 2024. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Rajkot, India.

PARKHOSPS.about: Park Medi World Limited operates a network of hospitals. The company provides cardiac sciences, neurosciences - brain and spine, plastic and cosmetic surgery, general and laparoscopic surgery, renal sciences and kidney transplant, bone, orthopaedics, joint replacement and sports medicine, gastroenterology and surgical gastroenterology, cancer care, bone marrow transplant, iMARS / robot-assisted surgery. It also offers bariatric surgery, anaesthesiology, critical care, chest and respiratory diseases, dental care, dermatology, endocrinology, paediatrics, internal medicine and geriatrics, rheumatology, ENT, ophthalmology, obstetrics and gynaecology, interventional radiology and imaging, psychiatry, pathology and microbiology, paediatric surgery, fertility management, nuclear medicine services. It operates NABH accredited multi-super specialty hospitals under the Park brand name. Park Medi World Limited was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

PARKHOTELS.about: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited owns, operates, and manages hotels in India. The company operates hotels under THE PARK, THE PARK Collection, Zone by The Park, Zone Connect by The Park, and Stop by Zone brands. It also operates restaurants, bars, night clubs, lounges, and cafés under the Flurys brand.
